summary: TIM S.A. filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of an ordinary current report on Form 8-K) containing minutes of a board meeting held September 17, 2026, primarily routine governance. Directors acknowledged committee reports, approved negotiating a Master Lease Agreement with SBA Torres Brasil, approved unspecified strategic projects subject to regulatory conditions precedent, approved R$515,000,000 in interest on shareholders' equity (JSCP) at R$0.2166801148 per share, authorized cancellation of treasury shares without capital reduction, and updated the Integrity Program organizational model. No special-situation transaction terms, premium, stake, or board recommendation on a control event are disclosed; watch only for future disclosure of the unidentified strategic projects.
